hypothesis: A real Deribit options vol-surface/greeks skew / risk-reversal (25Δ) trade (long one 25Δ wing / short the other, sized by the skew mean-reversion deviation, delta-hedged in the perpetual) is net-of-cost tradable for the underlying BTC/ETH perpetual on real, synchronized Deribit data.

protocol.title: Real Deribit options vol-surface/greeks skew / risk-reversal (25Δ) net-of-cost falsification
protocol.surface_to_iv: per real 5m snapshot & front expiry: IV backed out of each real quote mark (implied_volatility(mark*spot, spot, K, 0, T, type)); ~25Δ call = quoted call with |delta| nearest 0.25, ~25Δ put = quoted put with |delta| nearest 0.25 (both wings need a finite positive IV)
protocol.cost_model: net-of-cost: hedge turnover HEDGE_FEE_BPS on |Δhedge|*S; each of the 2 risk-reversal wings pays half its real bid/ask at entry and half at exit; full spread charged on risk-reversal side flips
protocol.option_spread: each of the 2 risk-reversal legs pays half its real bid/ask at entry and half at exit (long and short wings both charged the round-trip spread); full spread charged when the risk-reversal side flips between steps
protocol.pnl: dRR_k = exposure_k*side_k*((call_mark_{k+1}-call_mark_k)-(put_mark_{k+1}-put_mark_k))*S_k; gross_k = dRR_k + hedge_k*dS_k (hedge = -exposure*side*(call_delta - put_delta)); ret_k = (gross_k - cost_k)/S_k; decision at bar k -> outcome over [k,k+1] (causal)
protocol.skew_rule: skew = IV(~25Δ put) - IV(~25Δ call); deviation = skew - trailing median skew over skew_lookback_bars (causal); side = +1 (long RR: long call/short put) when deviation > 0, -1 (short RR) when deviation < 0, 0 when equal; exposure = clip(|deviation| / skew_target, 0, size_cap)
protocol.wing_selection_rule: ~25Δ call = quoted call with |delta| nearest 0.25; ~25Δ put = quoted put with |delta| nearest 0.25; both at the front expiry; else config invalid
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on both BTC and ETH and at least one grid config, net-of-cost Sharpe > 0, no kill-switch breach (max-DD <= 0.20), permutation p < 0.05, bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled PBO < 0.5; else NO-GO.
